import os
import aviary
from copy import deepcopy
from aviary.api import run_aviary
from aviary.models.missions.two_dof_default import phase_info as default_phase_info

# Get the path to aviary models
aviary_path = os.path.dirname(aviary.__file__)
aircraft_dir = os.path.join(aviary_path, 'models', 'aircraft')

    aircraft_file=aircraft_3500,
    phase_info=phase_info,
    run_driver=False,
    optimizer="SLSQP",
    verbosity=0,
    make_plots=False
)

    make_plots=False
)
